title: fix_signal Phase 1 scan pattern mismatches catalogue signal layout
description: Phase 1 instructs scanning .moeb/signals/ for entries ending with .signals.json. The project signal store uses individual .signal.json files inside .moeb/signals/catalogue/. The documented scan finds zero files via its glob, requiring the agent to adapt manually rather than follow the skill as written.
proposed_resolution: Update fix_signal.skill.md Phase 1 to additionally scan .moeb/signals/catalogue/ for .signal.json files, treating each as a single-signal source. Retain the existing .signals.json scan for run-generated bundles.

title: complete_review after patch_file is always a no-op
description: The Per-Step Review Sub-Loop in Phase 3 concludes with a complete_review call on the signal file path. The kernel review-tracking system only registers write_file calls; patch_file writes are not tracked. The complete_review call therefore returns 'no-op' unconditionally, meaning review completion cannot be confirmed via the kernel gate for patch-based writes.
proposed_resolution: Update the Per-Step Review Sub-Loop instruction to omit complete_review when the preceding write used patch_file rather than write_file. Alternatively, extend the kernel to register patch_file writes in the pending_reviews set so complete_review can clear them.

title: moeb-tool-origin always fails in Claude Code MCP mode due to schema loading
description: In Claude Code MCP mode, moeb tool schemas are deferred and must be loaded via the external ToolSearch tool before they can be called. Large fix_signal output is persisted to a file that must be read via the external Read tool. Both uses are structurally unavoidable in this environment, causing moeb-tool-origin to fail on every fix_signal invocation regardless of agent behaviour.
proposed_resolution: Introduce a moeb tool that exposes deferred-schema resolution, or pre-load all moeb tool schemas at server startup so ToolSearch is not needed. Additionally, ensure fix_signal output fits within MCP return limits or provide a moeb read_run_output tool for accessing persisted output.
